title: ReplyNeededOutput
description: Structured output of the classify.reply_needed route (004 research R2). The system skips a turn only when reply_needed is false and confidence >= skip_min_confidence. Superseded by specs/013-noncommittal-replies/contracts/reply-needed-output.schema.json (prompt v4: category informational, required decided_by); tests/contract/test_reply_needed_schema.py points there.

reply_needed.description: True when the user would normally answer: any question, request, new information calling for a response, disagreement, complaint, or a greeting that opens a conversation.

category.description: What the turn mainly is when it only closes the exchange; 'none' when it does something else.

resolves_pending.description: Only meaningful when pending_draft is true in the request: the turn says the earlier request is no longer needed (e.g. 'never mind, solved it, thanks'). False otherwise.
